Kiwi is your proactive assistant. It keeps track of what's coming up, your trips, plans, bills and the people in them, and texts you at the right moment. When something needs doing, it does it on any app or website when you say yes. Your Saturday is free: want a plan with the kids? Your flight is delayed: want a car for when you land? Your parcel needs a signature while you're at work: move it to Saturday? It all happens in iMessage or WhatsApp. Free during the pilot.

Aneesh Modi

Hi Product Hunt, I'm Aneesh, and I built Kiwi. [...] That's also why we're building the Kiwi Band, a band for your wrist with no screen. This takes your screen-time reduction goal to the next level. It buzzes when Kiwi needs you, and you answer with a tap or your voice, so your phone can stay in your pocket.

It's free during the pilot.

It always shows the price before booking, never types your card number, and never shows your passwords to an AI. It isn't perfect yet: some sites ask you to prove you're human. Tell me where it breaks. [...] Hi Product Hunt, I'm Aneesh, and I built Kiwi.

Most of us spend more time on our phones than we'd like. It isn't that we want to give up our digital lives: the flights, the bills, the replies and the plans all matter. But each one pulls us back to the screen, again and again.

Most assistants wait for you to ask. Kiwi texts you first, when something needs doing:

• "Your Saturday afternoon is free. Want me to plan something with the kids?" You say yes, pick a plan, and it books the tickets, lunch and the taxi

• "Your flight tonight is delayed an hour, so you'll land at about 1:20. Want me to book a taxi from arrivals?" One yes, and it's waiting when you land
